name: Wakasa (Tottori, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Wakasa town emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched pointed wings.
history: Municipal flag of Wakasa, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1958.

features.role: Wakasa town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched pointed wings
